title: C06: Implement the verified NFsim physical-unit count-rate bridge

source.contract: Physical-unit count and rate conversion for NFsim across molecularity, compartment volumes, and inter-compartment transport in strict unit mode

oracle.identity: Independent analytical count laws (Poisson, Binomial for decay and transport, pure-birth CTMC via DKW bounds), hand-derived scaling formulas, pinned BNG2, and native NFsim
oracle.law: Zero-order Poisson(lambda*t), unimolecular Binomial(N0, exp(-k*t)) for decay and transport, bimolecular pure-birth CTMC; hand-derived k_count Avogadro/volume/molecularity scaling formulas and strict dimensional failure guards.
